issues.description: Duplicate import statements in auth/page.tsx — useEffect and useState are imported twice from 'react', causing a compilation error and preventing Fast Refresh from working correctly.
issues.root_cause: Two separate import lines from 'react': line 2 imports `{ useEffect, useState }` and line 5 imports `{ FormEvent, useEffect, useMemo, useState }`. The compiler throws 'name is defined multiple times' errors for useEffect and useState.

issues.description: Hydration errors — multiple 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' errors, likely caused by the duplicate imports causing inconsistent render between server and client.
issues.root_cause: The compilation error from duplicate imports causes unstable rendering, leading to hydration mismatches between SSR and client.

fixes.new_str:
import { Cormorant_Garamond, Manrope } from "next/font/google";
import { FormEvent, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
fixes.reason: Remove the duplicate first import of useEffect and useState from 'react'. Keep only the more complete second import that also includes FormEvent and useMemo.
